description: Language-neutral vectors of the offload gate: whether a unit is offered to the fleet and whether it queues there (`queue`) or is declined at once when no machine has headroom. Signals are asked in order (mode, round trip, door, slot queue, host, broker); `asked` lists the ones a correct gate reads.

cases.name: pin offers and queues every unit without asking, even a cheap one on a calm machine
a unit cheaper than a round trip stays
the door that refused the build offers every unit and queues it on the fleet
a slot queue past the threshold offers and queues
a slot queue below the threshold does not make this machine saturated: the unit goes where another machine has headroom, without queueing
the host would make the unit wait: offers and queues
the build's own memory budget would make the unit wait while the host is calm: offers and queues
a broker that does not answer counts as calm: offered without queueing
a calm machine offers a worthy unit to any other machine with headroom and compiles it here when nobody has any
